status: research plan; no experiment in this matrix has been executed

fixed_identity_constraints.R4-v2: unchanged nonlinear market/task by solver-state joint fusion
fixed_identity_constraints.online_shell: MarketFramer, DecisionGate, RiskEngine, and Executor remain separate; WAIT stays first-class

budget_convention.screen_note: Two-seed screens can reject but cannot promote.
budget_convention.extension_note: Promotion still requires the repository's chronological, replay, economic, directional-control, cost, and independent-seed gates.

experiment_catalog.purpose: Establish what is already present before attributing novelty to Ataraxos.
checks: resolve the actual entropy, learning-rate, behavior-KL, PPO-clipping, and gradient-clipping configuration for each retained checkpoint
verify the implemented KL direction and whether adaptive KL is effectively zero
repair or confirm clip-fraction, critic explained-variance, advantage-distribution, and top-two-logit-margin diagnostics
record that for three always-legal actions KL(pi || Uniform[3]) equals log(3) minus policy entropy
experiment_catalog.budget: existing artifacts and deterministic checkpoint replay; no new training
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: a source-backed formula/config receipt that identifies the remaining distinct factor
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: do not launch an apparent Ataraxos ablation if it merely renames the existing entropy objective

experiment_catalog.purpose: Make recurrent training and replay evidence valid before drawing carried-memory conclusions.
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: finite forward/backward, correct (h,c) lifecycle, padded-loss exclusion, exact checkpoint replay, evaluation/train state parity
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: any leakage, state reset error, invalid mask, shared branch state, or replay mismatch

experiment_catalog.purpose: Complete the already-declared representation attribution before crossing in Ataraxos-derived optimizer or proposer factors.
experiment_catalog.identity_rule: R4-v2 remains the fixed nonlinear joint-fusion design and is neither changed nor redefined by this screen.
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: recurrent mechanics pass and at least one challenger remains measurable under paired held-out economic and directional controls
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: mechanics failure, replay mismatch, near-flat collapse, or a directional policy that cannot beat its matching static control

experiment_catalog.source_idea: Ataraxos dynamically damped self-play RL; the candidate novelty is coordinated schedule dynamics and explicit behavior-policy KL, not the uniform magnet by itself
experiment_catalog.anchor: one frozen accepted solver recipe after current R-series attribution closes; do not rename the solver
arms: regularization schedule only, with the entropy or distinct KL term predeclared after the formula audit
predeclared coupled schedule only if the isolated screens justify it
required_diagnostics: net return and Sharpe at exact 1 bp
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: an isolated or subsequently coupled factor avoids hard-flat collapse in both screen seeds and improves the frozen economic scalar without replay failure; a concentrated directional policy must also beat its matching static control and demonstrate conditional state dependence
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: greater than or equal to 98 percent flat, or greater than or equal to 98 percent short/long without beating the matching static control and demonstrating state dependence, or non-finite updates, control equivalence, or replay mismatch
experiment_catalog.caveat: A uniform action magnet adds no objective beyond entropy for the current three always-legal actions and may increase switching/turnover. iTrader already tested multiple entropy schedules; this is not presumed to cure the basins.

experiment_catalog.prerequisite: OPT-CONFIG-FORMULA-AUDIT plus trustworthy critic, clip-fraction, and advantage-distribution diagnostics; then either an OPT-DD decision or the frozen original recipe
experiment_catalog.accounting: Report environment samples, retained learner examples, optimizer updates, and wall-clock separately.
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: better held-out economic result or equal result at materially lower learner time, without action/position/regime/cost-stage selection bias
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: weak-critic outlier selection, directional/symbol/horizon/volatility/cost-stage sampling skew, rare-event erasure, worse calibration, or an efficiency claim that ignores environment collection

arms: EMA checkpoint from the identical run
experiment_catalog.budget: no additional training environment steps; paired replay only
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: lower across-checkpoint variance and equal-or-better replay-valid held-out economics
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: EMA obscures lineage, cannot restore exactly, or changes the selected policy without a recorded digest

experiment_catalog.source_idea: Sequential partial observability motivates a carried-memory test; this matched comparison already exists in iTrader architecture and does not establish a belief-state model
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: CARRY beats RESET on held-out chronological blocks with valid state norms, masks, replay, and economic controls
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: gain appears only under zero-state intervention, invalid reset/mask behavior, or no paired held-out uplift

experiment_catalog.source_idea: A prerequisite suggested by Ataraxos belief-conditioned search, but not a direct belief-network transplant because trading has no labelled hidden opponent board or uniquely true latent regime
external_prerequisites: close the existing C0/C1/shuffled-C1 causal-feature controls before PF policy crossing
retain the accepted existing R-series solver as the frozen policy anchor
experiment_catalog.budget: supervised train-only fit with three initialization seeds; measure examples, accelerator time, and peak memory before PPO
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: held-out proper-score and calibration improvement across chronological blocks and regimes
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: future leakage, train-fitted regime leakage, miscalibration, target unavailable online, or a claim that a forecast distribution is a supervised posterior over the true market state

experiment_catalog.axis: predictive-state factor by accepted solver cross
arms: accepted solver with frozen predictive-state distribution
experiment_catalog.identity_rule: Cross as solver x PF; do not rename or absorb into R4-v2, C, or S.
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: predictive-distribution arm beats all controls under matched capacity and held-out economics
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: shuffled/zero predictive features match the gain, solver ignores the predictive distribution, or calibration degrades under policy-induced states

experiment_catalog.source_idea: A valid counterfactual simulator is a prerequisite for Ataraxos-style search.

contract.market_transition: P(next market observation | causal history), action-independent for the current historical no-impact environment
contract.portfolio_transition: exact deterministic function of position, action, turnover, cost, and termination

experiment_catalog.budget: prediction-only validation before any policy search; report one-step and multi-step calibration versus simple baselines
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: stable held-out multi-step proper scores, coverage, path statistics, and exact portfolio accounting
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: uses actual future bars, invents action-driven price impact, or fails calibration/path statistics

experiment_catalog.source_idea: Ataraxos belief samples plus depth-limited rollouts plus one regularized tabular policy update
experiment_catalog.prerequisite: accepted frozen PF and WM artifacts plus a calibrated frozen policy/value blueprint
experiment_catalog.budget: paired replay/shadow evaluation only; no solver weight updates; report milliseconds per decision and scenario count
experiment_catalog.root_update: A stateless tabular/logit policy improvement at the current decision; do not describe it as online neural-weight fine-tuning.
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: cost-aware held-out uplift over policy-only and equal-compute controls with calibrated uncertainty and first-class abstention
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: branch state is not cloned, latency exceeds the declared shadow budget, improvement depends on actual future bars, or world-model controls perform similarly

experiment_catalog.source_idea: Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data learning-progress reward
experiment_catalog.prerequisite: one frozen, repeatable solver recipe and untouched chronological final test
arms: cloned checkpoint after one equal-compute candidate-task micro-update
experiment_catalog.interpretation: Repeated local intervention/reference estimate, not oracle truth.
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: repeated pre/post held-out economic uplift yields a usable task ranking across checkpoints and seeds with uncertainty narrower than the decision margin
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: proposer sees the sealed final test, changes verifier/reward semantics, or panel and rollout noise dominate the measured task differences
experiment_catalog.identity_rule: This is an AZR curriculum factor, not R-, PF-, C-, S-, or R4-v2 evidence.

experiment_catalog.source_idea: Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data optimizer-preconditioned gradient alignment
experiment_catalog.prerequisite: AZR-LP-DIRECT produces a repeatable held-out economic-uplift ranking on pinned solver snapshots and rollout batches
scores: policy-head, value-head, and shared-trunk alignment reported separately
task loss/difficulty and gradient norm baselines
experiment_catalog.budget: reuse the pinned candidate batches and checkpoints from AZR-LP-DIRECT; report gradient/JVP compute and memory separately from environment steps
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: per-seed and pooled rank association with repeated direct uplift is positive, uncertainty excludes zero, and the score generalizes across checkpoints
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: association is driven by reward scale or gradient norm, reverses across seeds/checkpoints, or uses sealed-test evidence
experiment_catalog.identity_rule: A validated proposer-scoring factor only; it does not change solver architecture, TaskSpec semantics, or R4-v2.

experiment_catalog.source_idea: Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data fresh/mutate/replay plus quality diversity
experiment_catalog.prerequisite: stable proposal identity and centralized, versioned feedback; adaptive utility waits for AZR-LP-DIRECT or AZR-LP-GRAD validation
arms: Fixed-QD with identical typed fresh/mutate/replay machinery and no adaptive utility
experiment_catalog.budget: G7a uses two SRU; G7b adds at most two SRU per screen after Fixed-QD passes
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: coverage improves without economic loss, then adaptive selection beats Fixed-QD and shuffled selection at equal accepted solver steps and eligible data
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: invalid TaskSpec mutation, panel specialization, task collapse, process-local feedback loss, or unequal solver/proposal compute
experiment_catalog.identity_rule: This extends the AZR proposer/curriculum wing; it does not create a market player or alter the solver's R-, C-, S-, or R4-v2 identity.

experiment_catalog.purpose: Measure the maximum value of action alternatives under the realized action-invariant price path without confusing hindsight with deployable search.
experiment_catalog.contract: Alternative portfolio accounting may reuse the realized market path only under the explicit price-taker assumption; the result is labelled oracle/hindsight and may never select a live or held-out decision.
experiment_catalog.budget: deterministic replay over the frozen evaluation panel
experiment_catalog.keep_gate: quantifies whether decision-time search has enough theoretical headroom to justify a learned scenario model
experiment_catalog.stop_gate: any claim that the oracle is an online policy, or any use of actual future bars as solver input
